content: “Kumwail samworo kan, kumwail rong! Kumwail mehn Israel kan, kumwail rong kanahieng! Kumwail kisehn nanmwarki kan, kumwail pil iang rong! Kumwail kin pweisanki kapwung meteikan— eri, kapwungpamwail pahn wiawi! Kumwail wialahr lidip ehu nan Mispa, uhk ehu me kohdiong pohn Nahna Tapor,
pwoahr loal ehu nan kahnimw Akasia, oh I pahn kaloke kumwail koaros.
I wehwehki ia mwomwen Israel—e sohte kak ruksang ie. E solahr loalopwoatohng ie, oh nah aramas akan solahr konehng re en kaudokiong ie.”
Oseia Kehkehlingki Suwed en Pwongih Dikedik en Eni
Dihp me aramas akan wiadahr kahrehda arail solahr pwurodohng rehn arail Koht. Pwongih dikedik en eni katengeiraillahr, oh re sohte kin pohnese KAUN-O.
Pohnmwahsohn Israel wia mehn kadeikparail. Diparail kan kahrehiong ar dipekelekel oh pwupwudi; oh mehn Suda kan kin iang irail pwupwudi.
Re kin ale neirail sihpw oh kou kan wiahki arail mehn meirong ong KAUN-O, ahpw met sohte pahn katepe. Re sohte pahn kak diarada KAUN-O, pwe e ketin likidmelieiraillahr.
Re solahr loalopwoatohng KAUN-O; neirail seri kan solahr wia sapwellime. Eri met, sapwarail akan pahn mwadangete mwomwla.
Kumwail peuk sowi nan Kipea! Pakairpen keper en wiawi nan Rama! Wia weriwer en mahwen nan Pedapen!
Kumwail ohl en Pensamin kan, kumwail wenewohng nan mahwen!
Rahnen kalokoloko samwodohr, oh Israel pahn ohla. Kumwail mehn Israel kan, kumwail en ese me met uhdahn pahn pweida.
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “I engieng pwehki kaunen Suda kan ar mahweniong Israel oh pirapahsang sapwe. Eri, I pahn kamwerediong pohrail kalokolok rasehng lapake ehu.
Israel milahr nan apwal. E luhsangehr sahpw akan me uhdahn doakedoake en sapweniki, pwehki eh ngidingidki en repen sawas rehn irail kan me sohte kak sewese.
Eri, I pahn ketikihdo mwomwla pohn Israel oh ong aramas akan en Suda.

“Ni ahnsou me Israel kilangehr uwen soumwahu me e ahneki, oh ahnsou me Suda kilangehr pein eh ohla kan, Israel ahpw kohla Asiria pwehn peki sawas rehn nanmwarki lapalapo, ahpw e sohte kak kamwahwihirailla de kamowehdi ar ohla kan.
I pahn mahweniong mehn Israel oh Suda, rasehng laion emen. Pein ngehi pahn kapisetikihirailpeseng oh keseirailla. Ni ei pahn wurahdekirailla, sohte emen pahn kak doareirailla.
“I pahn kesehla nei aramas akan lao arail lokolok pahn itar pwainla diparail kan oh pahn pwurodo rapahkin ie. Pwehki arail lokolok, ele re pahn song rapahkin ie.”
